t0030-01.gloss: A restaurant order remains unpaid while a routine water check delays the catch.
t0030-01.rival_reading: Officials could have restricted food during an emergency; the note never says what the water check was looking for.

t0030-02.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
t0030-02.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
